reason: I'm not paying today for a brand I've never heard of, with no reviews, for a jar I won't get until January. Gummies with sugar and glucose syrup in them sit badly with me when I'm trying to look after my health, and I'd rather see what other women my age say before parting with money.
objection: It's sugar and glucose syrup, and I'd be paying nearly £20 up front for something I can't try or see reviewed before mid-January.
would_change_my_mind: Proper reviews from women my age who have used it for a month or more, and a clear sugar figure per gummy printed on the packaging.
